remarks: - - - - - NEW PICTURES ARE COMING SOON = = = = Introducing a brand-new 2026 estate that brings Westside-caliber design to the heart of Woodland Hills. Behind private gates, this two-story residence of approximately 5000 square feet pairs Jerusalem stone with smooth plaster under modern gabled rooflines. Every finish was selected without compromise. Inside, 10-foot ceilings, 9-foot custom doors, and walls of glass fill the home with natural light. Glass doors slide fully into the walls and open the living room in two directions.
